dialogues.speaker: Erfan
dialogues.text: Pfft... Makes me laugh every time...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you...

dialogues.speaker: Erfan
dialogues.text: I am the one who walks under the veil of night, a listener of drunkards' most honest confessions...

dialogues.speaker: Erfan
dialogues.text: Hahaha, just kiddin'! I'm just a bartender working night shifts here.

dialogues.speaker: Erfan
dialogues.text: Many come here to drink at night. Some of them might get quite drunk. So Lambad had me take some of Qishan's shifts.

dialogues.speaker: Erfan
dialogues.text: An Akademiya student during the day and a bartender at night. I'd say I've managed to keep a good work-study balance.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything fun about this place?

dialogues.speaker: Erfan
dialogues.text: Of course, there's lots of fun stuff.

dialogues.speaker: Erfan
dialogues.text: This is a tavern, after all. The last thing we lack is funny drunkards.

dialogues.speaker: Erfan
dialogues.text: Like last time, a student who had just come of age drank too much at his birthday party and, as a result, tried to have a duel with a chair.

dialogues.speaker: Erfan
dialogues.text: ...Well, the chair definitely turned out to be the stronger duelist.

dialogues.speaker: Erfan
dialogues.text: A Liyue student who came with him captured the hilarious moment and sent the pictures to The Steambird overnight.

dialogues.speaker: Erfan
dialogues.text: Guess what, one of the pictures earned the Second Prize for journalistic photography. I heard it was only second to the work of The Steambird's top reporter.

dialogues.speaker: Erfan
dialogues.text: If I were the drunken student, I'd blackmail... send a letter to ask for royalties.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Erfan
dialogues.text: Goodbye... Hahaha...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Qishan...

dialogues.speaker: Erfan
dialogues.text: Qishan is the bartender during the day. Have you met her already?

dialogues.speaker: Erfan
dialogues.text: She's a student from Liyue who is now preparing for the entrance exam to the Akademiya. She also works to cover her tuition. That's hardly an easy life.

dialogues.speaker: Erfan
dialogues.text: I want to help, but I'm from a different school than the one she's aiming for.

dialogues.speaker: Erfan
dialogues.text: So I sometimes invite students from that school over for a drink. This way, she can discuss academic questions with them.

dialogues.speaker: Erfan
dialogues.text: I hope she will pass the exam. That will make me her senior!
